dialogue.t: That's easy! Just click on the exclamation mark at the top-left corner of the screen and you can view all the quests you have taken on so far.
Some quests are really hard, and there's no way you will be able to complete them until you reach the right level for that quest. If your level isn't high enough, you're too weak.
